title: Starting harmony and thorough bass lessons with Eddie Hudson
summary: With free daytime hours, he found a teacher and studied harmony and thorough bass with Eddie Hudson from 1922 to 1925, leaving St. Louis around 1926.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Well, when you're in St. Louis, did you ever go to the Chauffeur's Club?
That was a famous place down by the river, I think.
Yes, that's what I'm coming to. So, I stayed at the theater there for awhile and then I began to

practice on my horn and I got that foursome, you know, because I didn't have anything to do but just go to the theater, get off early, get up in the morning, practice on my horn and sit around, and I told my wife, I said, "I'm going to find me a teacher and go study." They called it thorough bass and harmony back there in those days. PAUSE I studied with Eddie Hudson. So, (stayed with) I studied with Eddie for around about four -- from 1922 until '25.
Yeah, well, after that, just a little longer than that. I left around about '26.
